dct_title_s: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba : Roads (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: Road network across the region from OSM. Includes everything tagged with `highway`: motorways, residential streets, service roads, footways, and trails. Useful for routing, accessibility analysis, and evacuation planning. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:highway](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:highway) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
